Its current ability choices and Fighting typing must be assessed at its obtainable level, before evolving into Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan, Hitmontop. Relevant own-list milestones: Mach Punch at 1, Rapid Spin at 1, Fake Out at 6. Evolution route: dbbbw EVOLVE_HOLDING, 20, BRICK_PIECE, HITMONTOP; dbbbw EVOLVE_STAT, 20, ATK_LT_DEF, HITMONCHAN; dbbbw EVOLVE_STAT, 20, ATK_GT_DEF, HITMONLEE. Low stats are appropriate for an early/baby or intentionally restricted stage; judge access to useful training moves and the evolution route rather than raising it to final-evolution strength.

ability_synergies.description: Boosts Speed when it flinches.

ENTEI.name: Entei

Assess whether a selected Fire attack qualifies for Sheer Force; a move's secondary effect is not automatically removable. Do not add setup or more Speed merely to match Raikou's special offense.
